Bootstrap Introduction.exp: Introduction to Bootstrap and its ecosystem.

What is Bootstrap: Bootstrap is the world's most popular front-end component library, providing a responsive grid system, pre-built UI components, and utility classes. It uses a mobile-first approach with 12-column grid, five responsive breakpoints (xs, sm, md, lg, xl), and Sass variables for customization. Bootstrap 5 dropped jQuery dependency and uses vanilla JavaScript for interactive components.
Hello, Bootstrap!
Grid System: Bootstrap's grid uses flexbox with 12 columns across five breakpoints. Rows are wrappers for columns; columns specify width via col-{breakpoint}-{size}. Equal-width columns use col. Auto-layout with col-{breakpoint} adjusts per breakpoint. Nest rows inside columns. Offsets push columns right. Gutters control spacing via g-* classes.

Breakpoints & Containers: Bootstrap provides five breakpoints: xs (<576px), sm (≥576px), md (≥768px), lg (≥992px), xl (≥1200px), xxl (≥1400px). Containers center content horizontally: .container (max-width per breakpoint), .container-fluid (full width), .container-{breakpoint} (full width until breakpoint). Use d-* display utilities to show/hide elements per breakpoint.

Columns & Gutters: Columns use 12-unit system. Column classes: col-{breakpoint}-{size} or col-{size} without breakpoint. Use .row-cols-* to control number of columns per row on all breakpoints. Gutters: g-0 (no gap), g-1 through g-5 (increasing), gx-* (horizontal), gy-* (vertical). Column wrapping happens when more than 12 units are used in a row.

Alignment & Ordering: Flexbox alignment classes for rows and columns. Vertical: align-items-start/center/end, align-self-*. Horizontal: justify-content-start/center/end/around/between. Column ordering with order-{breakpoint}-{number}. First and last with order-first/order-last. Margin auto with me-auto/ms-auto centers in flex containers.

Buttons & Button Groups: Bootstrap buttons use .btn with contextual classes: btn-primary, btn-secondary, btn-success, btn-danger, btn-warning, btn-info, btn-light, btn-dark, btn-link. Outline variants with btn-outline-*. Sizes: btn-lg, btn-sm. States: active, disabled. Button groups with .btn-group for horizontal grouping, .btn-group-vertical for vertical. Toolbars combine multiple groups.
Cards: Cards are flexible content containers with optional header, body, footer. Build with .card, .card-body, .card-title, .card-text, .card-img-top. Card groups (.card-group) display as attached equal-width cards. Card decks (.card-deck deprecated — use row + cols instead). Horizontal cards with .row.g-0 > .col-md-4 + .col-md-8 inside card.

Navbar & Navigation: Navbar is a responsive navigation header. Base: .navbar with .navbar-expand{-breakpoint}. Brand: .navbar-brand. Nav links: .navbar-nav with .nav-item and .nav-link. Toggler for mobile with data-bs-toggle=collapse. Supports dropdowns, forms, text, and color schemes (navbar-light/dark with bg-*). Sticky-top and fixed-top positions.

Modals & Alerts: Modals are dialog boxes built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Structure: modal, modal-dialog, modal-content (header + body + footer). Trigger with data-bs-toggle=modal and data-bs-target. Sizes: modal-sm, modal-lg, modal-xl. Centered with modal-dialog-centered. Scrollable with modal-dialog-scrollable. Alerts: .alert with .alert-{color}. Dismissible with .alert-dismissible + data-bs-dismiss=alert.

Images & Figures: Responsive images: .img-fluid (max-width:100% + height:auto). Thumbnail: .img-thumbnail. Image alignment: .float-start, .float-end, .mx-auto.d-block. Picture element support. Figures with <figure> + .figure, .figure-img, .figure-caption. Rounded corners: .rounded. Aspect ratios via ratio and ratio-{x}x{y} helpers for embedded content.
Tables: Base .table. Variants: table-striped, table-hover, table-bordered, table-borderless, table-sm (compact). Contextual rows/headers: table-{active|primary|secondary|success|danger|warning|info|light|dark}. Responsive tables: wrap in .table-responsive (or .table-responsive-{breakpoint}). Table dark with .table-dark. Align top with align-middle/align-top.

Form Controls & Inputs: Form controls use .form-control on <input>, <textarea>, and <select>. Supported inputs: text, password, email, number, tel, url, search, date, time, datetime-local, month, week, color, file. Sizing with .form-control-lg, .form-control-sm. Readonly with readonly attribute. Disabled with disabled attribute. Plain text with .form-control-plaintext for displaying values as text.
Select & Checks: Custom select with .form-select. Sizing: form-select-lg, form-select-sm. Multiple select with multiple attribute. Checkboxes: .form-check-input wrapped in .form-check with .form-check-label. Radios same pattern. Inline with .form-check-inline. Switch type: .form-check-input type=checkbox role=switch. Disabled states supported on all.
Validation: Form validation uses .was-validated on <form> after submission or .needs-validation for custom validation. HTML5 validation constraints: required, minlength, maxlength, min, max, type, pattern. Visual feedback: .is-valid, .is-invalid, .valid-feedback, .invalid-feedback. Tooltip style: .valid-tooltip, .invalid-tooltip. Server-side validation by adding classes manually.

Floating Labels: Floating labels use .form-floating wrapper around form-control and label. Supports inputs and textareas. The label sits inside the input moving to a floating position on focus or when filled. Browser autofill is handled automatically. Works with selects and validation states. Ideal for streamlined forms.

Sass Variables & Maps: Bootstrap uses Sass variables and maps for customization. Key variable file: _variables.scss. Override before importing Bootstrap. Theme colors map: $theme-colors. Grid: $grid-breakpoints, $container-max-widths, $grid-columns. Spacing: $spacer with $spacers map. Utility API generates utility classes from Sass maps. Root variables via $prefix and CSS custom properties.
CSS Custom Properties: Bootstrap 5 sets many CSS custom properties on :root and components. Root: --bs-primary, --bs-body-color, --bs-border-radius, etc. Component-level: --bs-accordion-bg, --bs-modal-width. Override at runtime via CSS or JavaScript. Disable with $enable-css-variables: false. This enables dynamic theming without rebuilding Sass.
Components & Theming: Bootstrap offers multiple component Sass variants: accordion, alerts, badges, buttons, cards, carousel, dropdowns, forms, list group, modal, nav, navbar, offcanvas, pagination, popovers, progress, scrollspy, spinners, toasts, tooltips. Enable/disable components via $enable-* variables: $enable-button-pointers, $enable-caret, $enable-rounded, $enable-shadows, $enable-gradients, $enable-transitions, $enable-reduced-motion, $enable-smooth-scroll, $enable-grid-classes, $enable-container-classes, $enable-cssgrid, $enable-validation-icons.

Modal & Offcanvas: Modal via data-bs-toggle="modal" or JavaScript API: new bootstrap.Modal(element).show(). Methods: show, hide, toggle, dispose, handleUpdate. Events: show.bs.modal, shown.bs.modal, hide.bs.modal, hidden.bs.modal. Options: backdrop (true/static/false), keyboard, focus. Static backdrop prevents close on backdrop click. Offcanvas similar API: offcanvas-start/end/top/bottom.
Tooltip & Popover: Tooltips use Popper for positioning. Initialize with data-bs-toggle="tooltip" or JavaScript. Options: animation, container, delay, html, placement (top/bottom/left/right/auto), sanitize, selector, template, title, trigger (click/hover/focus/manual). Popovers extend tooltips with header + body content. Initialize: new bootstrap.Popover(element). Both need manual initialization for dynamically added elements.

<!-- HTML markup -->
<button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary"
  data-bs-toggle="tooltip" data-bs-placement="top"
  title="Tooltip on top">
  Hover me
</button>

<button type="button" class="btn btn-lg btn-danger"
  data-bs-toggle="popover" title="Popover title"
  data-bs-content="And here's some content.">
  Click for popover
</button>

// Initialize all
const tooltipTriggerList = [].slice.call(
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]')
);
tooltipTriggerList.map(el => new bootstrap.Tooltip(el));

const popoverTriggerList = [].slice.call(
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-toggle="popover"]')
);
popoverTriggerList.map(el => new bootstrap.Popover(el));

// With custom options
new bootstrap.Tooltip(element, {
  delay: { show: 500, hide: 100 },
  html: true
});
Collapse & Accordion: Collapse toggles content visibility: data-bs-toggle="collapse", data-bs-target="#id". Accordion groups collapses with .accordion + .accordion-item structure. Accordion flush removes borders/background. Stay-open variant with data-bs-parent="#accordion" removed. Methods: show, hide, toggle. Events: show.bs.collapse, shown.bs.collapse, hide.bs.collapse, hidden.bs.collapse.

Carousel & Toast: Carousel cycles through images with previous/next controls and indicators. Base: .carousel.slide with .carousel-inner > .carousel-item. Options: interval, pause, wrap, keyboard, touch. Crossfade with .carousel-fade. Methods: cycle, pause, prev, next, dispose. Toasts: lightweight notification component with .toast. Auto-hide with data-bs-delay or options. Trigger manually via Bootstrap.Toast.

ScrollSpy & Tabs: ScrollSpy auto-activates nav links based on scroll position. Add data-bs-spy="scroll" to the scrollable element with data-bs-target="#navId". Works with nav, list-group, or simple links. Tab component toggles content panes: nav-tabs + tab-content with tab-pane. Active via show class. Fade with fade class. Methods: show, dispose. Events: show.bs.tab, shown.bs.tab.

Sticky & Fixed Positioning: Fixed top: .fixed-top (position:fixed + top:0). Fixed bottom: .fixed-bottom. Sticky top: .sticky-top (position:sticky + top:0). Sticky bottom: .sticky-bottom. Responsive sticky: .sticky-{breakpoint}-top. Z-index utilities: z-index utilities via z-* classes. Stacking context-aware. Sticky elements stay in flow until scroll threshold, unlike fixed elements removed from flow.
